item.title: Shots Fired in Midland Park Mall Parking Lot
item.description: MIDLAND, TX — Midland police are investigating a case of deadly conduct after a large group of juveniles fought in the parking lot of Midland Park Mall near Dick's Sporting Goods on Friday, with shots fired and evidence of possible injury found at the scene. Officers responded around 1 p.m. to reports of a disturbance with weapons involving 50-60 high school-aged juveniles fighting in the parking lot. Callers reported hearing what they believed were gunshots associated with the fight. Learn More

item.title: City Honors 2025 Employees of the Year
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX - The City of San Angelo recognized employees during its 2025 Employee Appreciation Luncheon held Feb. 19 at the McNease Convention Center. item.title: LIVE! Daily News | San Angelo Tip Cracks Murder Case
item.description: Today on LIVE!, Ryan Chadwick covers stories, including a San Angelo woman's key cooperation that helped identify suspects and break open the 2019 murder case of U.S. Army Pvt. Gregory Wedel-Morales. We also highlight the San Angelo Police Department's $1.23 million federal grant for critical 911 and records tech upgrades, secured by Congressman August Pfluger. Plus, an exclusive interview with Rose Wilhoyt, Manager of the Angelo State Natural History Collections.Today's stories: Learn More Here

item.title: No. 1 Wall Stifles No. 2 Coahoma to Claim Region I Championship
item.description: BIG SPRING, TX — The No. 1 Wall Lady Hawks took another step towards hoisting a state championship trophy in the Regional Final against No. 2 Coahoma in Big Spring on Friday night. Despite a tight contest in the first two quarters, Wall proved too deadly on defense and pulled away in the second half. The Lady Hawks claimed the victory and the 3A Div II Region I Championship 56-42. Learn More Here.

item.title: Central Bobcats’ Incredible Comeback Falls Just Short Against Crowley
item.description: ABILENE, TX — The Comeback ‘Cats didn’t go down without a fight.Trailing by 20 points at halftime in their second-round playoff game to Crowley, the San Angelo Central boys basketball team stormed back to get within three points in the final minutes before losing 76-65. Learn More Here.

item.title: Cadillac Destroyed in Knickerbocker Road Crash
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A two-vehicle collision at the busy intersection of Knickerbocker Road and Valleyview Boulevard disrupted traffic flow in southwest San Angelo on Saturday afternoon, February 28, 2026. The incident, which occurred just after 3 p.m., led to the complete shutdown of all southbound lanes on Knickerbocker Road, with authorities diverting traffic northbound onto Valleyview Boulevard to manage the congestion.
